responsibility: Provides the MSP430 backend’s target header configuration, defining preprocessor builtins, driver/assembler/linker specs, register numbers and classes, calling-convention macros, frame/elimination setup, exception-handling registers, section and assembly-output conventions, debugging defaults, and miscellaneous target macros that bind generic GCC infrastructure to the MSP430 implementation. It is the central target-description header that wires msp430.cc logic and driver spec functions into GCC’s target interface.
same_name_distinction: This header supplies the target-description macros, register and calling-convention definitions, and driver/assembler/linker spec glue that bind GCC infrastructure to MSP430. Unlike msp430.cc it is not the backend's executable hook implementation, unlike msp430.md it does not encode instruction-selection patterns, and unlike msp430.opt it does not declare command-line options.
